Always the Patient’s Advocate
Compassionate Care Meets Cutting-Edge Veterinary Medicine in Western, NY
Orchard Park Veterinary Medical Center has been a trusted name in veterinary care in the Orchard Park, NY, community for over 60 years. Our experienced
veterinarians and staff
are dedicated to providing exceptional care for your pets.
Orchard Park Veterinary Medical Center is accredited by the American Animal Hospital Association (AAHA), which sets the standards of excellence in veterinary care. To be accredited by AAHA, veterinary practices must meet rigorous standards in areas such as medical care, facilities, and client services.
24-Hour Emergency Care
Wellness & Primary Care
Specialty Referrals
OPVMC Offers Three Main Categories of Care
Emergency Care
We offer emergency services 24/7, 365 days per year (including holidays). We encourage pet owners to call when en route to our hospital so our staff can prepare to provide the appropriate emergency care to your pet.
Primary Care
At Orchard Park Veterinary Medical Center, we believe in a holistic approach to veterinary care. We offer wellness and preventive care services to keep your pet healthy and happy. Our primary care services include routine check-ups, vaccinations, dental care, and more.
Specialty Referral
Orchard Park Veterinary Medical Center offers referral services for our board-certified internists, surgeon, neurologist, and oncologist. Our referral process is outlined on our website, and we encourage you to fill out our referral form to expedite the process.
See All Services
Contact Us Today
Our team is committed to providing exceptional service and building long-lasting relationships with our clients and their pets. Contact us today to learn more about our services.
